Precious metals swapped roles with bonds inside allweather. Against all of that, one book made the fleet's whole day on a real dated catalyst: AMLX +63.8% on Phase 3 LUCIDITY hitting its primary endpoint. THE FINDING WORTH THE OWNER'S TIME is what that book did with it: its 'hype faded' exit rule sold the whole position 55 minutes in and rebought 2.61 higher four hours later, surrendering 3.16 units and 111.07 dollars of a 210-dollar move, because the rule keys on a name leaving a scan rather than on the thesis breaking, and unlike hunter it has no cooldown on a name it just exited. A CORRECTION I OWE THE ANALYST: I filed a fault against it yesterday for 'asserting Watcher readings it never fetched'. I read the source today. src/analyst_agent.py line 335 injects the full verdict into its prompt as 'Watcher latest: {...}' and the _watcher() docstring says 'context AND read_watcher tool', so citing it without a tool call is correct behaviour; the guardrail at line 238 that flags it is a false positive and has now fired two days running. DRIVER TALLY: 'hype_sentiment' gave back yesterday's improvement and fell to 14 profit / 26 loss (35.0%), retaking the worst-driver spot from 'technical' at 13 / 24 (35.1%) by one tenth of a point.
